text: I feel like an observer on the threshold between the enclosure of shared human activity and the outward-facing celebration of human innovation. Within the glass room, people gather in groups, learning or collaborating—a microcosm of community, perhaps education. Outside, the vibrant R+D display showcases collective progress and inquiry, inviting individual reflection on the purposes of knowledge and discovery. Amidst these spaces, I feel a quiet sense of curiosity and belonging, suspended between dialogue and contemplation.
